clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 3: the 16 gcc-compiled uint256 routines of the validator binary monad 0.16.7 (runtime udiv, sdiv, umod, smod, addmod, mulmod, exp, monad::addmod, mulmod, exp, udivrem<4,4>, <5,4>, <8,4>, knuth_div, monad_vm_runtime_mul and _mul_192) compute the specified words on 321,391 cases with zero mismatches.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I re-disassembled each routine from dl/p167/data/usr/local/bin/monad with objdump, bounded by its nm size, and compared the instruction column with the text the unit emulated (out/dis167). All 16 are equal; knuth_div differs only by one trailing alignment nop that lies past the nm size. I then drew 124,549 fresh cases of my own (seed 99173; power-of-two neighbours, limb patterns of 0, 1, 2^63, 2^64-1, values near 2^256 and 2^255, 160-bit and shifted 128-bit words, random words) over DIV, MOD, SDIV, SMOD, ADDMOD, MULMOD, MUL, MUL192 and EXP through the unit's x86 model and Python references: zero mismatches. The plant runs (out/plant1-3.json) show the model reports mismatches when the routine text is altered, so a pass is not vacuous. The src sites that reach these routines were read: FullMath.sol:24, 35, 48, 62, 67, 73, 112, UnsafeMath.sol:14 and 26, TickMath.sol:104. The scope limit the unit states stands: this tests the routines, not the emitter's literal folds or register logic.

clearedSpotChecks.note: With my own script (readelf section and symbol tables, file offset from section address) I extracted the 11 InstDB symbols _additionalInfoTable, _altOpcodeTable, _commonInfoTable, _instFlagsTable, _instInfoTable (13,784 bytes), _instNameIndexTable, _instNameStringTable, _instSignatureTable, _mainOpcodeTable (984 bytes), _opSignatureTable and _rwFlagsInfoTable from monad 0.16.7 and from cycles/023/theme-monad-compiled-coverage.work/build/asmjit/x86instdb.o.
